Run or save a script written by mv_ask()

Source: R/ask.R
run_script.Rd

run_script() runs the script in a fresh environment and returns the objects it created (for example mod, sel, dif_res, scores). With check = TRUE it first runs the whole script on simulated data with the same structure as yours (same items, categories and groups) in a temporary folder, so errors show up before your data are touched. save_script() writes the script to a .R file.

Usage

run_script(x, check = FALSE, echo = interactive())

save_script(x, file = "analysis.R", open = FALSE)

Arguments

x

an mv_script from mv_ask().

check

logical; do a dry run on simulated data first.

echo

logical; print each line and its output as it runs.

file

path of the .R file to write.

open

logical; open the file in the RStudio or Positron editor (needs the rstudioapi package).

Value

run_script(): a named list of the objects the script created, invisibly. save_script(): the file path, invisibly.

Examples

scr <- mv_ask(data = Science, plan = mv_plan(model = "graded", steps = "fitcheck"))
f <- save_script(scr, tempfile(fileext = ".R"))
# \donttest{
res <- run_script(scr, echo = FALSE)
# }
